title: NBA Prediction SOTA 2026: Logistic+Isotonic achieves Brier 0.199 — corroborated by P7 POL live best

logistic_regression_calibrated.notes: Best tabular baseline on 2024-25 NBA test data. CalibratedClassifierCV isotonic wrapper is key.
logistic_regression_calibrated.source: PMC/Nature Scientific Reports 2025: Stacked ensemble model for NBA game outcome prediction (PMC12357926)

xgboost_calibrated.notes: 2nd best tabular. Already in our GA MODEL_TYPES but likely without CalibratedClassifierCV isotonic.

cnn_rolling_window.notes: Matches our GA fleet level. Requires sequence data — not feasible on CPU islands.

elo_features.note: Top-3 predictor across all 2026 studies: home_next_elo, team_elo_5y, team_elo. Verify present in features/engine.py v3.1.

corroboration.p7_pol_live: P7 (LBJLincoln/political-alpha-7) logistic_regression achieves POL LIVE BEST 0.24924 at gen 32058 — confirms logistic is a strong algorithm in our GA framework, not just in literature.
corroboration.implication: If logistic achieves 0.24924 in political (272 features, 1180 events), it could plausibly reach 0.199-0.220 in NBA (3377 features, 9551 games) with isotonic calibration.

proposed_changes.change: Add 'logistic_regression_calibrated' to MODEL_TYPES: sklearn LogisticRegression(C=0.1, max_iter=1000) wrapped in CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=3)
Verify ELO-style features present: home_elo, away_elo, elo_diff, home_form_5g, away_form_5g. Top-3 SOTA predictors.
Add stacking meta-learner: LogisticRegression meta on OOF predictions from XGBoost + ExtraTrees + RandomForest (3-fold). SOTA stacked ensemble approach.
proposed_changes.effort: HIGH — requires OOF generation in GA fitness eval

quick_win.action: Add logistic_regression + CalibratedClassifierCV isotonic to MODEL_TYPES in features/engine.py. ~10 lines. Immediate GA candidate on next island mutation.
quick_win.expected_impact: Potential Brier improvement from current 0.22062 toward 0.20-0.22 range, corroborated by both SOTA literature and live P7 performance.
